name: DrupalAuth for SimpleSAMLphp
description: This module tightly integrates the SimpleSAMLphp Identity Provider login experience with a Drupal site.

suggests.drupal/tfa: Improve the security posture of your identity provider with two-factor authentication

project_description:
🇺🇦 
 
 This module is maintained by Ukrainian developers.

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 Drupal + SimpleSAMLphp + drupalauth = Complete SAML Identity Provider (IdP)

 Users interact with Drupal to create accounts, manage accounts, and authenticate. SAML SPs interact with SimpleSAMLphp . Drupalauth ties Drupal to SimpleSAMLphp.

 This module turns your Drupal site into Identity Provider together with drupalauth simpleSAMLphp module.

 Please read installation instructions on GitHub .
